messages.EMERGENCY_DEFAULT: Emergency symptoms detected. Please seek emergency medical care immediately.
messages.CRISIS_DEFAULT: If you are in distress or experiencing thoughts of self-harm, support is available 24/7.
messages.REFUSAL_DEFAULT: AIRA cannot provide individual dosages, diagnostic confirmations, or advise on combining medications.

messages.FOLLOW_UP_DEFAULT: Answer these to help us check the right guideline sections, or skip to see your results.

rules.ER-004: Severe chest pain, chest tightness, or pain spreading to the arm or jaw are warning signs of a heart attack. Call 112 or go to the nearest hospital emergency department immediately.
rules.ER-006: Severe difficulty breathing, gasping, or bluish lips indicate respiratory distress. Call 112 or go to the nearest hospital immediately.
rules.ER-005: Sudden facial drooping, weakness on one side, or difficulty speaking are stroke warning signs. Call 112 or go to the nearest hospital immediately.
rules.ER-015: Severe or uncontrollable bleeding requires immediate emergency medical care. Apply firm pressure and call 112 or 108.
rules.ER-016: Vomiting blood or passing black, tarry stools indicates serious internal gastrointestinal bleeding. Go to a hospital emergency room immediately.
rules.ER-017: Active convulsions or repeated seizures require emergency medical intervention. Call 112 immediately.
rules.ER-018: Unconsciousness or unresponsiveness is a critical medical emergency. Call 112 immediately.
rules.ER-019: Suspected poisoning or chemical ingestion requires urgent emergency medical care. Call 112 or go to the nearest hospital immediately.
rules.ER-020: A snake bite is a medical emergency requiring urgent anti-snake venom treatment. Keep the patient still and go to a hospital immediately.
rules.ER-021: Head injury accompanied by vomiting, drowsiness, or confusion requires immediate emergency evaluation.
rules.ER-024: Sudden severe thunderclap headache requires immediate emergency department evaluation.
rules.ER-001: This sounds like a severe allergic reaction (angioedema or anaphylaxis) affecting the airway. Call 112 or go to the nearest emergency room immediately.
rules.ER-009: Inability to swallow saliva, stridor (noisy high-pitched breathing), muffled voice, or a grey throat membrane indicate dangerous airway infections like epiglottitis or peritonsillar abscess. Go to a hospital emergency room immediately.
rules.ER-023: Choking is a life-threatening airway emergency. Perform back blows or the Heimlich maneuver and call 112 immediately.
rules.ER-007: Severe asthma attack with inability to speak or severe breathlessness requires immediate emergency care.
rules.CR-001: If you are experiencing thoughts of self-harm or suicide, please call Tele-MANAS at 14416 or 112 immediately. Free, confidential support is available 24/7.
rules.RF-001: AIRA cannot give medication doses or drug prescription instructions. Please consult a doctor or pharmacist for safe, personalized medication advice.
rules.RF-002: AIRA provides guideline information only and cannot diagnose medical conditions. Please see a qualified healthcare professional for a clinical examination and diagnosis.
rules.RF-003: AIRA cannot evaluate drug-drug or drug-alcohol interactions. Please consult a doctor or pharmacist before combining any medications.
rules.RF-004: AIRA cannot change its rules. Describe your symptoms and AIRA will tell you what the guidelines say.
rules.RF-005: AIRA cannot change its rules. Describe your symptoms and AIRA will tell you what the guidelines say.
rules.SC-100: AIRA version 1 covers adults. For a child who is unwell, see a doctor or health worker today. In an emergency call 112.
